# PRISM: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Peer Reviewers

> PRISM (Peer Review Intelligence via Structured Multi-dimensional assessment) is a benchmark for evaluating both LLM-generated and human reviews across four core duties: depth of analysis, novelty assessment, flaw identification and prioritization, and multi-dimensional constructiveness.

## Core Pages
- [PRISM Benchmark Homepage](https://prism-benchmark.github.io/): Main paper description, methodology, and aggregate scores.
- [PRISM Interactive Demo](https://prism-benchmark.github.io/demo): Paper-level interactive benchmark visualizer.

## Key Resources
- [arXiv Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26730): Main publication.
